content.caption:
⬇️

👉In my first year of BTech, I was obsessed with one thing: building websites.
I jumped straight into frontend and started creating e-commerce projects. I was excited… but things didn’t go exactly as planned. I didn’t touch backend, and I felt like I was missing something.

In my second year, I started watching roadmap videos on YouTube. Almost every creator said the same thing:
“Everyone should start with web development.”

That confused me.

Because deep down, I didn’t just want to be a web developer. I wanted to become an AI engineer. And I kept wondering “how is web development going to help me build AI systems?”

But after building a few projects, something clicked.

I realized web development isn’t separate from AI. It’s the bridge.
You can build the smartest AI model in the world, but without a clean interface, without integration, without a way for people to use it… it stays invisible.

That’s when I decided to combine both worlds.
Web Development + AI Systems.

Instead of choosing one, I chose to integrate AI into websites, solve real problems, and then gradually move deeper into building models.

And that changed everything.

If you’re confused between Web Dev, AI, or any other path maybe you don’t have to choose. Maybe you just have to connect the dots.

What are your thoughts on this? 👇 Let’s talk
